title: KasaMonitor
description: TP-Link Kasa / Tapo smart plugs and Shelly Gen2/Gen3 devices exported by KasaMonitor: power, voltage, current, energy, cost, online/offline and relay per plug; energy meters (Shelly EM) in their own row.

options.content: **KasaMonitor** — TP-Link Kasa (legacy), Tapo (KLAP / AES) and Shelly Gen2/Gen3 (protocol `shelly-rpc`) devices with energy metering: power (W), voltage (V), current (A), energy (kWh) and cost per plug. KasaMonitor polls the plugs every 10 s and exposes `/metrics`; Prometheus scrapes it (job `kasa`). `kasa_power_total` is **cumulative Wh**; kWh = Wh / 1000. Energy over a range = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases (a drop, e.g. after a restart or a plug reset, is not counted; a scrape gap longer than 5 minutes loses the energy of that gap). Cost = kWh × **$tariff $currency/kWh** (dashboard variables, top left). 30-day windows are complete only after 30 days of data. A plug that is unplugged or off Wi-Fi shows **offline** (red); W/V/A/relay keep the last good reading. A plug withdrawn in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive, "Retrage") is no longer polled and disappears from the metrics. Voltage and current appear only for plugs that report them. Every series has a `role` label (`plug` | `main` | `sub`, set per channel in KasaMonitor /dispozitive). The totals at the top count only `role="plug"`: the main meter and the sub-meters already include the plugs behind them. The house (main meter) is in the **Contor general** row at the bottom (power, rest of the house = house − plugs, voltage, power factor, energy per day); other meter channels are in **Sub-contoare**.

panels.title: Power now
panels.description: Sum of instantaneous power (W) of all plugs: sum(sum by (alias) (kasa_power_load{role="plug"})). Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Plugs online / total
panels.description: Plugs answering right now, and all plugs exported by KasaMonitor (offline included). Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Energy (24 h)
panels.description: kWh used by all plugs in the last 24 hours. Energy = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases, clamped at 0: sum_over_time(clamp_min(max by (alias) (kasa_power_total) - max by (alias) (kasa_power_total offset 5m), 0)[RANGE:5m]). Not increase(): kasa_power_total is re-seeded from the plug's own total when KasaMonitor restarts (and Tapo plugs report month-to-date energy), so the series can drop a little; increase() treats any drop as a counter reset and would add the whole cumulative value as new consumption. A gap longer than 5 minutes loses the energy of that gap. Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Cost (24 h, $currency)
panels.description: Cost of the last 24 hours: kWh × $tariff. Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Energy (30 days)
panels.description: kWh used by all plugs in the last 30 days (complete only after 30 days of data). Energy = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases, clamped at 0: sum_over_time(clamp_min(max by (alias) (kasa_power_total) - max by (alias) (kasa_power_total offset 5m), 0)[RANGE:5m]). Not increase(): kasa_power_total is re-seeded from the plug's own total when KasaMonitor restarts (and Tapo plugs report month-to-date energy), so the series can drop a little; increase() treats any drop as a counter reset and would add the whole cumulative value as new consumption. A gap longer than 5 minutes loses the energy of that gap. Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Cost (30 days, $currency)
panels.description: Cost of the last 30 days: kWh × $tariff. Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Plugs
panels.description: One row per plug. online = answered the last poll; relay = on/off (last good reading). W/V/A = last reading; kWh / cost = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases in the window. Last online: within 30 days, 5-minute resolution (empty = not online in 30 days). model / protocol come from KasaMonitor labels (protocol: legacy, klap, aes). Every column is aggregated by alias, so a plug keeps one row when its labels change (e.g. after an upgrade that adds labels); model / protocol come from a separate query joined on alias.

panels.title: Power per plug
panels.description: Instantaneous power (W) per plug.

panels.title: Energy per day (30 days)
panels.description: kWh per plug and day (stacked bars = daily total). Each bar covers the 24 h before its timestamp; days are aligned to 00:00 UTC and the current day is not shown. Energy = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases, clamped at 0: sum_over_time(clamp_min(max by (alias) (kasa_power_total) - max by (alias) (kasa_power_total offset 5m), 0)[RANGE:5m]). Not increase(): kasa_power_total is re-seeded from the plug's own total when KasaMonitor restarts (and Tapo plugs report month-to-date energy), so the series can drop a little; increase() treats any drop as a counter reset and would add the whole cumulative value as new consumption. A gap longer than 5 minutes loses the energy of that gap. Only channels with role="plug" are counted: the main meter (role="main") and the sub-meters (role="sub") already include the plugs behind them; the role is set per channel in KasaMonitor (/dispozitive). Meters have their own rows at the bottom.

panels.title: Energy per plug (selected range)
panels.description: kWh per plug over the dashboard time range. Energy = sum of the counter's 5-minute increases, clamped at 0: sum_over_time(clamp_min(max by (alias) (kasa_power_total) - max by (alias) (kasa_power_total offset 5m), 0)[RANGE:5m]). Not increase(): kasa_power_total is re-seeded from the plug's own total when KasaMonitor restarts (and Tapo plugs report month-to-date energy), so the series can drop a little; increase() treats any drop as a counter reset and would add the whole cumulative value as new consumption. A gap longer than 5 minutes loses the energy of that gap.

panels.title: Cost per plug (selected range, $currency)
panels.description: Cost per plug over the dashboard time range: kWh × $tariff.

panels.title: Online / offline per plug
panels.description: Green = the plug answers, red = it does not (unplugged, off Wi-Fi, or KasaMonitor stopped polling it).

panels.title: Relay per plug
panels.description: Green = the plug powers its load, orange = switched off (button or app). An offline plug keeps its last known state.

panels.title: Voltage per plug
panels.description: Mains voltage (V) measured by each plug (only plugs that report it).

panels.title: Current per plug
panels.description: Current (A) drawn through each plug (only plugs that report it).

panels.title: House power now
panels.description: Active power (W) of the main meter: sum(kasa_power_load{role="main"}). Set the main meter in KasaMonitor /dispozitive (one per installation).

panels.title: Rest of the house now
panels.description: Main meter minus the plugs: sum(kasa_power_load{role="main"}) - sum(kasa_power_load{role="plug"}). What is consumed by everything that is not on a monitored plug (plugs offline count as 0).

panels.title: Grid voltage now
panels.description: Voltage (V) measured by the main meter: avg(kasa_voltage{role="main"}). Red outside 207–253 V (230 V ± 10 %, EN 50160).

panels.title: House power factor now
panels.description: Power factor of the main meter: avg(kasa_power_factor{role="main"}).

panels.title: House power and rest of the house
panels.description: House = sum(kasa_power_load{role="main"}); rest of the house = house − sum of the plugs (role="plug"). Plugs are sampled every 10 s like the meter; the 1-second stream is only in KasaMonitor (/contor).

panels.title: Grid voltage
panels.description: Voltage of the main meter (kasa_voltage{role="main"}). Threshold lines at 207 V and 253 V (230 V ± 10 %).

panels.title: House power factor
panels.description: Power factor of the main meter (kasa_power_factor{role="main"}).

panels.title: House energy per day (30 days)
panels.description: kWh per day of the main meter, from its cumulative counter (kasa_power_total{role="main"}), same method as "Energy per day": sum of the 5-minute increases, days aligned to 00:00 UTC. KasaMonitor's History uses the meter's own per-minute records instead.

panels.title: Sub-meter power per channel
panels.description: Active power (W) per sub-meter channel (kasa_power_load{role="sub"}). Negative = reversed clamp or energy exported.

panels.title: Sub-meter energy per day (30 days)
panels.description: kWh per sub-meter channel and day (kasa_power_total{role="sub"}), sum of the 5-minute increases, days aligned to 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: Burner
panels.description: Burner on/off and modulation of the Viessmann boiler (heating_burner_active, heating_burner_modulation_percent). Read from the ViCare cloud every 120 s by default.

panels.title: Burner modulation
panels.description: heating_burner_modulation_percent (0 when the burner is off).

panels.title: Gas today: hot water vs heating
panels.description: heating_gas_consumption_m3{period="day"}: the boiler's own estimate for today (not a gas meter), per purpose.

panels.title: Boiler online / API calls today
panels.description: heating_online (last read within three poll intervals) and heating_api_calls_today (HTTP calls to Viessmann, API and token endpoint, made today by KasaMonitor; local calendar day, resets at midnight and at a restart). The free plan limit is 1450 calls per sliding 24 h.

panels.title: Boiler temperatures
panels.description: Supply, hot water (and its target), boiler target (20 °C when idle), room; outside/return/boiler only on boilers with those sensors (not on a Vitodens 050-W).

panels.title: Burner modulation
panels.description: heating_burner_modulation_percent over time (stepped: one value per poll).

panels.title: Gas per day (30 days): hot water vs heating
panels.description: m³ per day and purpose from KasaMonitor's cumulative counter heating_gas_consumption_m3_total (sum of the 5-minute increases, days aligned to 00:00 UTC, like the other daily panels). KasaMonitor's Centrală page shows local days.

panels.title: Detected appliances: power
panels.description: Estimated power of the appliances that KasaMonitor detects as running now from the main meter (kasa_appliance_power_w, NILM): the switch-on step of each open run. Only appliances you named or seen at least 10 times in 30 days; appliances measured by a plug are not here (they have kasa_* series). Stacked; the rest of the house is not shown.

panels.title: Detected appliances: energy (selected range)
panels.description: kWh of the finished runs of each detected appliance in the selected range (increase of kasa_appliance_energy_wh_total; the counter starts at 0 when KasaMonitor restarts, which increase() handles).

panels.title: Unidentified energy (24 h)
panels.description: House energy not explained by the plugs or the detected appliances in the last 24 h (increase of kasa_nilm_unidentified_wh_total).

panels.title: Appliance events (24 h)
panels.description: Steady-state steps of the main meter recorded as events in the last 24 h (increase of kasa_nilm_events_total).

list.name: tariff
list.label: Tariff per kWh
list.description: Electricity price per kWh used by the cost panels.
